title: Breakout continuation edges have no positive net edge after friction
hypothesis: Pre-declared continuation rules (breakout start, residual shock) have a positive mean net R after fees and tiered slippage on the development window. RETROSPECTIVE REGISTRATION: this record was written AFTER the run it documents (the run produced its artifact at 2026-10-19T11:37:10Z); it transcribes that run's preserved artifacts and must not be read as a prospective pre-registration. The sweep tested the continuation rule family, NOT the funding-quintile hypothesis of HYD-0001.

feature_definitions.name: sigma
feature_definitions.definition: per-bar EWMA Garman-Klass volatility of the closed 5m bars, lagged (the current bar is excluded); the triple-barrier stop distance is k_stop * sigma * sqrt(horizon_bars)

feature_definitions.name: beta
feature_definitions.definition: EWMA covariance of the coin's log return with the BTC log return over the trailing bars, divided by the EWMA variance of the BTC return; capped at 3.0 and floored at 0

feature_definitions.name: z
feature_definitions.definition: BTC-residual log return of the bar divided by the lagged EWMA volatility of that residual (the CUSUM input)

feature_definitions.name: rvol
feature_definitions.definition: time-of-day relative volume: the quote volume of the latest 3 bars divided by the median of the same slot on each of the previous 14 days (at least 5 lags required)

feature_definitions.name: qv24
feature_definitions.definition: trailing 24h quote volume in USDT (288-bar ring); the liquidity-group key and the slippage-tier key

feature_definitions.name: breakout_start
feature_definitions.definition: the first bar of a run of closes outside the prior 48-bar channel (the channel excludes the bar itself), gated on rvol >= rvol_min

feature_definitions.name: residual_shock
feature_definitions.definition: two-sided CUSUM on the standardized residual z; an event fires when the statistic crosses h, then the state resets and a 12-bar cooldown applies

universe: every coin with an archived bar file in data/bars except BTC (578 files at the 2026-10-18 data-readiness snapshot); BTC is loaded only as the market factor
point_in_time_membership: A coin joins the traded universe with its first archived bar and leaves at the end of its last contiguous run; features are computed inside a contiguous run only (a new run restarts the feature stream and its 6-day warmup) and a label path may not cross a timestamp gap. An event is only recorded when the coin's trailing-24h quote volume is at least 1e6 USDT (the tradeable floor), its EWMA volatility is non-degenerate, and the full label horizon fits inside the run. Coins that list later contribute only from their listing; no coin is back-filled.

costs.source: proto/quant/config.py CostModel (quant-v1): taker 0.05pct per side plus per-side slippage by trailing-24h quote volume (30M/10M/3M/1M floors). The selection metric is friction only and does NOT model funding; the artifact's funding-adjusted blocks are reporting only.

statistics.test: day-cluster bootstrap 95% interval on the window mean, plus a max-t SPA multiplicity correction over the 288 declared configurations
statistics.code_note: the code hash is pinned to the revision the sweep ran from (the artifact's git_rev); five of these files have changed since, so the working tree is not the code that produced the numbers
statistics.regime_note: the volatility/regime groups of a sliced report are trailing volatility terciles of each event's own sigma; they are NOT comparable with the six-state codes of proto.quant.estimators.regime, which needs the market-factor return series

promotion_criteria.name: holdout_ci_lower_bound
promotion_criteria.test: 95% day-cluster bootstrap CI lower bound of the holdout mean net R

promotion_criteria.name: validation_mean_net_r
promotion_criteria.test: validation mean net R (friction only) of the dev-selected config

promotion_criteria.name: spa_p_value
promotion_criteria.test: best-of-configs max-t (SPA) p-value on the dev window

promotion_criteria.name: slippage_2x
promotion_criteria.test: holdout mean net R with slippage doubled stays above zero

variants.description: Completed 288-configuration sweep (8 pre-declared rules x 36 pre-declared geometries) over the development window, then the dev-selected configuration re-evaluated on the validation window; friction-only metric; the one-shot holdout was NOT spent.

detail.outcome: no evidence of a positive edge: every dev and val interval straddles zero and every point estimate is negative
detail.holdout_note: the one-shot holdout stays sealed; the artifact's holdout fields are null and no decision to spend it was taken
detail.input_digests: the per-coin bar / funding / settlement digests of the input archives are recorded inside the artifact (bar_digests, funding_digests, settlement_digests); the artifact's own sha256 is the evidence hash and is covered by this record's data_hash
detail.funding_adjusted_note: the artifact's dev_funding_adjusted / val_funding_adjusted blocks predate the 2026-10-19 cost/split audit and are superseded by funding-transitions.json; the friction-only rows quoted here are unchanged
